title: GromovMilman
abstract: Formalization of Theorem 1 (the Gromov–Milman conjecture on polynomials restricted to subspaces) from Dol'nikov–Karasev, "Dvoretzky type theorems for multivariate polynomials and sections of convex bodies" (arXiv:1009.0392): for any even d > 0 and any k, there exists n(d, k) such that every homogeneous polynomial of degree d on R^n (n >= n(d, k)) restricts on some k-dimensional subspace V to a scalar multiple of (x_1^2 + ... + x_n^2)^(d/2). The formalization provides an unconditional, constructive proof without sorry or external topological black boxes: Carlsson's theorem on non-abelian 2-groups is eliminated in favor of an elementary abelian Dold-type Borsuk–Ulam theorem ((Z/2)^r) proved from scratch on chain complexes and applied inductively level-by-level to iterated wreath products via block-structured join embeddings.
